title: 2.3 Fungi
description: Fungal structure, reproduction, nutrition and the roles of yeasts, moulds and mushrooms. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? A eukaryotic organism that absorbs nutrients from its surroundings
Which term matches this description? A thread-like filament that makes up the body of a fungus
Which term matches this description? The interconnected network of hyphae forming a fungal body
Which term matches this description? A tough polysaccharide that strengthens fungal cell walls
Which term matches this description? A cross-wall dividing a hypha into separate cells
Which term matches this description? A fungal hypha with no cross-walls and many nuclei
Which term matches this description? A reproductive cell that can develop into a new fungus
Which term matches this description? A sac-like structure in which fungal spores are produced
Which term matches this description? A form of asexual reproduction where a new cell outgrows the parent
Which term matches this description? An asexual spore produced at the tip of a hypha
Which term matches this description? A unicellular fungus that reproduces mainly by budding
Which term matches this description? A fungus that grows as a network of hyphae on surfaces
Which term matches this description? The fruiting body of a fungus that produces spores
Which term matches this description? A symbiotic association between fungi and plant roots
Which term matches this description? A symbiosis between a fungus and an alga or cyanobacterium
Which term matches this description? An organism that feeds on dead and decaying organic matter
Which term matches this description? A fungus that obtains nutrients from a living host
Which term matches this description? Fungi release enzymes to digest food before absorption
Which term matches this description? A fungus that can exist as either yeast or mould
Which term matches this description? The scientific study of fungi and their relationships
